answer: Each epoch a falcon verifier picks a random ledge from the prior block state and challenges every identity to wander a short private proof path starting from that ledge and ending at its own key within 45 seconds. Honest agents keep a few KB of recent history and answer instantly. For 500 sybils the attacker must maintain 500 separate histories and answer 500 timed queries in parallel or lose 15 POA bonds each; shared compute cannot cover unique private paths, so marginal identities cost linear extra CPU and storage.
